hints.content:
We want to complete $x^2\blueD{+20}x$ into a perfect square.

To do that, we should add $\left(\dfrac{\blueD{+20}}{2}\right)^2=\goldD{100}$ to it:

$x^2\blueD{+20}x+\goldD{100}=(x+10)^2$

In order to keep the expression equivalent, we add and subtract $\goldD{100}$, not forgetting the expression's constant term, $-86$:

$\begin{align}
f(x)&=x^2+20x-86
\\\\
&=x^2+20x+\goldD{100}-86-\goldD{100}
\\\\
&=(x+10)^2-86-100
\\\\
&=(x+10)^2-186
\end{align}$

In conclusion, after completing the square, the function is written as

$f(x)=(x + 10)^2 - 186$
